output.answer: As of November 2026, C&S Wholesale Grocers' subsidiaries — which it brands its "family of companies" — are SpartanNash (acquired September 22, 2025, including its military distribution business), Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, and The Davidson Specialty Food Group (Davidson Specialty Foods). C&S's September 2025 SpartanNash completion release also listed FreshKO Produce Services, a Fresno, CA produce distributor it acquired as "a wholly-owned subsidiary," in the family of companies, though FreshKO does not appear on the current cswg.com family-of-companies page. Through SpartanNash, C&S also operates more than 200 corporate-run grocery stores under banners including D&W Fresh Market, Grand Union, Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets and Piggly Wiggly.
caveats: FreshKO Produce Services is named in C&S's September 2025 family-of-companies description and as a wholly-owned subsidiary at acquisition, but it does not appear among the logos on the current cswg.com 'Our Family of Companies' page as of 2026-11-11 — it may have been integrated into another unit.

C&S presents these as its 'family of companies'; the corporate site does not publish a formal legal-subsidiary list, so operating divisions such as SpartanNash's Military Distribution business are included alongside separately named subsidiaries.
Subsidiaries beneath SpartanNash itself (e.g., its own retail banners and military distribution segment) are not enumerated on C&S's pages.

passages.quote: C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC is a leader in food solutions across the United States. Established in 1918, C&S had its start as a supplier to independent grocery stores. Today, the C&S family of companies — including Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group™, FreshKo Produce Services, The Davidson Specialty Food Group and SpartanNash® — delivers innovative supply chain solutions, products and services to chain, independent and military customers from 60 distribution centers nationwide. C&S offers a comprehensive range of products for every aisle of the grocery store, from fresh produce to household goods, including within our private label portfolio. C&S operates more than 200 corporate-run grocery stores primarily under the banners: D&W® Fresh Market, Grand Union®, Family Fare®, Martin’s™ Super Markets and Piggly Wiggly®. C&S is deeply committed to corporate citizenship, actively supporting various charitable causes that help enrich and feed our communities. For more detailed information, please visit our website at cswg.com.

KEENE, N.H. – September 22, 2025 – C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC (“C&S”) today announced the completion of its acquisition of SpartanNash Company (“SpartanNash”). The combined company employs more than 30,000 team members and operates almost 60 complementary distribution centers covering the U.S. and serves close to 10,000 independent retail locations, as well as military commissaries and exchanges, with more than 200 corporate-run grocery stores.

key_facts.fact: C&S Wholesale Grocers completed its acquisition of SpartanNash Company on September 22, 2025; the combined company employs more than 30,000 team members and operates almost 60 distribution centers.
C&S's family of companies as stated in its September 2025 release: Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, FreshKo Produce Services, The Davidson Specialty Food Group and SpartanNash.

The current cswg.com 'Our Family of Companies' page (retrieved 2026-11-11) lists Davidson Specialty Foods, Hansen Distribution Group, Grocers Supply, SpartanNash and SpartanNash Military Distribution.
C&S (founded 1918, HQ Keene, NH) operates more than 200 corporate-run grocery stores under the banners D&W Fresh Market, Grand Union, Family Fare, Martin's Super Markets and Piggly Wiggly.
FreshKO Produce Services, Inc. (Fresno, CA, 142 employees) was acquired and continues to operate under the FreshKO brand as a wholly-owned subsidiary of C&S Wholesale Grocers, Inc.
